hints: k-th smallest = the k-th node visited by an inorder traversal, because inorder is sorted. Count nodes as you visit them.
Pass the counter by pointer (int *count) so it survives across recursive calls, and stop the traversal once you have the answer.

successorOf with no parent: descend from the root; every time you go LEFT record the node you left as the best candidate, and going right never produces a candidate. The last recorded candidate is the successor.
source: Core of NITC_Lab_S2_PD Lab 12 Q2 (which forbids the parent pointer)
title: k-th smallest and successor without a parent pointer
